name: webs
description: Connect agents to Webs memory over remote MCP: save, recall, ask, watch, run, readiness, and on-demand context.

tools.name: save
tools.description: Save URL(s) or content into analyzed Webs memory. Agent deposits carry task and why.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve saved memory with hybrid semantic and lexical search, citations, excerpts, and scores.

tools.name: context
tools.description: Return a small on-demand task-affinity context packet for an agent. Never automatic injection.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answer questions over saved memory with citations and modes for saved-only, saved-memory, or fresh-then-saved.

tools.name: watch
tools.description: Create or list monitors that keep standing topics feeding memory.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Start durable research, compare, or monitor-snapshot runs and return a poll contract.

tools.name: readiness
tools.description: Probe auth, entitlement, scope, and tool availability for the Webs MCP connection.

skills.name: webs-memory
skills.description: Judgment rule for deciding when to use Webs memory.

skills.name: webs-save
skills.description: Save durable findings with task and why.

skills.name: webs-recall-ask
skills.description: Choose recall versus ask versus fresh search.

skills.name: webs-context
skills.description: Request small on-demand context packets without hooks.

metadata.readiness: Remote MCP endpoint configured at https://webs.creative-int.com/mcp. Auth is client-owned; bearer tokens stay in client credential stores or environment variables, never in this repository.
